Iron Moth

Fire Poison

Paldea · Generation 9

Iron Moth is a Fire/Poison-type Paradox Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 36 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (140), with a base stat total of 570.
